new-and-changed-responsibilities.text: Validators, mirror, runners, verifier, docs page, and workflows, each with its responsibility and its must-not. The flowchart shows the ruling flowing into validators and mirror, then journeys, verifiers, and docs.

dependency-direction.text: The ruling flows into validators and mirror together; journeys and verifiers consume both; docs describe the deployed result. Lean stays upstream and unchanged.

promotion.text: No new shared library. The registry parameter is promoted into the policy head because mint, burn, and withdraw all enforce it; the application stays unparameterized.
